how_it_works: Milan trains candidate brains per job kind with blind tests: the model answers without knowing it is being graded, and the result is scored against the expected outcome.
Lessons come from results only — never from the owner's wording. Test questions are never stored.
There are no permanent incumbents. Every model re-proves itself on a rolling cycle: a re-trial every 30 days or every 50 jobs in a kind, whichever comes first.
A model or provider change — a new release, a price change, a retirement — re-opens testing for the affected kinds.

rules: Graduation: a cheaper brain is proposed only after ≥ 35 straight good blind tests in a job kind, plus 14 days of history in that kind.
The first switch in each kind needs the owner's yes.
Every switch is on probation for 20 jobs or 14 days, with automatic rollback on any drop in results — a single owner correction also rolls it back.
Training data is results only — never personal information. The trained core can be copied without the personal layer.
